description: Küstenschutzbauwerke im Küstenmeer Mecklenburg-Vorpommern und der AWZ (StaLU MM, Ostsee vor M-V, Stand: 2017) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Dennis Gräwe. This dataset contains location and type of point- and line-shaped coastal protection structures in the territorial sea of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern as well as in the German EEZ (Baltic Sea before M-V): - bank walls - stone walls - rubble walls - dunes - dikes - groans - breakwaters. Coverage: the territorial sea of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and the German EEZ. The portal shows the English title as "Coastal protection structures in the territorial sea of Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania and the EEZ (StaLU MM, Baltic Sea " (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Dennis Gräwe. Its keywords include Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, MDI-HA, Anthropogenic pressures, Ostsee, Baltic Sea, Human activities. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
